ideas.title: The Impact of Medicaid Cuts on Minnesota Healthcare
ideas.description: Investigate the impact of the Trump administration's halt on $259 million in Medicaid payments to Minnesota on healthcare services in the state.
questions: How will the Medicaid cuts affect healthcare services in Minnesota?
What are the potential long-term consequences for healthcare access and quality?
ideas.insight: The Medicaid cuts could have significant consequences for healthcare access and quality in Minnesota, particularly for vulnerable populations.

ideas.title: FBI Raids on High-Profile Figures: A Pattern of Corruption?
ideas.description: Investigate the recent FBI raids on high-profile figures, including Los Angeles School Superintendent and FBI agents involved in the Trump investigation.
questions: What are the allegations against the high-profile figures?
Is there a pattern of corruption or wrongdoing?
ideas.insight: The recent FBI raids suggest a potential pattern of corruption or wrongdoing among high-profile figures, warranting further investigation.
